spec.prompt: Recreate the REAL 1960s apartment blocks of Huambo's Rua Cinco shown in the reference photos as ONE isometric game building: five floors, concrete frame facade with long balconies whose parapets are painted in faded red, turquoise and cream, laundry hanging, satellite dishes, water tanks on the flat roof, ground floor with small shops behind roll-up metal doors and grilles, visible weathering and stains, exactly in the style of the photos.

request.prompt:
High-definition 2D game art for a modern, polished life-simulation game (cozy, detailed, professional mobile game quality). Clean digital illustration with crisp edges, soft painterly shading, gentle ambient occlusion, warm natural daylight coming from the top-left. Consistent isometric camera: 2:1 dimetric projection (about 30 degrees elevation, rotated 45 degrees), as in classic isometric life-sim games.
Single isolated building game asset viewed from the isometric camera, the whole building visible including roof and base, both visible facades (front-left and front-right) detailed. Transparent background, no ground tiles, no street, no people, no text other than shop signs explicitly requested.
Recreate the REAL 1960s apartment blocks of Huambo's Rua Cinco shown in the reference photos as ONE isometric game building: five floors, concrete frame facade with long balconies whose parapets are painted in faded red, turquoise and cream, laundry hanging, satellite dishes, water tanks on the flat roof, ground floor with small shops behind roll-up metal doors and grilles, visible weathering and stains, exactly in the style of the photos.
Setting: the real city of Huambo, Angola, exactly as shown in the attached reference photographs of present-day Huambo. Reproduce the real architecture, materials, colors, wear, signage style, vegetation, street furniture, vehicles and the way people dress as seen in those photos. Do not invent a generic city.
Avoid: pixel art, low resolution, blur, photo-realism, 3D render look, watermarks, extra limbs, cropped parts, background scenery.
